NAME:
   rancher logs - Show logs of Rancher components (server, agent, fleet-agent, kube-api-auth, webhook, api-extension)

USAGE:
   rancher logs [flags] <server|agent|fleet-agent|kube-api-auth|webhook|api-extension>

FLAGS:
   --cluster id|name      target cluster id|name
   --container container  container name (default: the containers and init containers of each pod)
   --help, -h             show help
   --pod pod              restrict to one pod name, to read the logs of a single replica
   --previous             logs from the previous container instance
   --since duration       logs newer than this duration, e.g. 30m, 2h; omit for no limit
   --tail lines           max lines (default 200)
   --timestamps           prefix each line with a timestamp

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
